title: 3D Component Hover Select and Edge Preview
description: Fix vertex/edge/face hover and selection in WGPU world engine and lowpoly plugin; add Show Edges window option toggle.
summary:
Code and tests were already landed prior to this session: numeric-id sync (infinite/world/rs/lib.rs:3520), vertex/face/edge hover-select overlay tests (:3573/:3600/:3871), the `preview_survives_sync_when_scene_json_unchanged` regression test (:3969) for the optimistic-preview-wiped-by-stale-cache bug, and lowpoly's `toggleShowEdges` test (lowpoly/plugin/rs:2751).

Re-verified this session: `cargo test -p infinite_world --lib` passes all 25 tests including `preview_survives_sync_when_scene_json_unchanged`. Rebuilt the wgpu renderer WASM and plugin WASM (both required a fresh build since the crate had been non-compiling before this session's ViewState/RasterScene schema fixes, tracked under 26/07/11/WGPU-RENDERER-FULL-PARITY) and booted the lowpoly playground under wgpu — console shows a clean `[DEBUG] wgpu renderer booted` with no hover/select/edge-preview errors.

Interactive pixel verification (actually hovering/clicking/toggling Show Edges and observing the result) was not possible in this session: this headless Browser pane's WebGPU canvas never presents visible pixels despite a valid `navigator.gpu` adapter and error-free boot — the same environment gap documented in `.repo/🎫️/26/07/04/RUST-PLUGIN-FRAMEWORK-MIGRATION/parity-gap-update.md` and confirmed via a non-WebGPU screenshot sanity check. Closing on the strength of the unit test suite (which directly encodes the hover/select/edge-preview/toggle behaviors) plus clean boot; interactive confirmation needs a real (non-headless) browser.
